name:
Zero Escape:
Zero Time Dilemma
description:
Zero Escape: Zero Time Dilemma pushes the boundaries of interactive storytelling with brutal new puzzles and fully animated story chapters!
While the story is brought to life with English and Japanese dubbing options, new members and familiar faces round out the powerful cast of characters.
Multiple endings and a non-linear story will keep you coming back for more!
